test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

It seems that great progress has been made by many developing nations.

options.text: It seems that many developing nations have made great progress.
It seemed that great progress has made many developing nations.
It seemed that great progress has been made by many developing nations.
It seems that great progress has made many developing nations.

solution:
The correct answer is: **It seems that many developing nations have made great progress.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the Present Perfect Simple tense.
 
• The Present Perfect Simple in the passive voice has the following form: Object + have/has + been + verb3 (past participle) + Subject__
 
• The Present Perfect Simple in the active voice has the following form: __Subject + has/have + past participle form of the verb + object__
 __
 
• Passive: *Football has been played by them.*
 
• Active: *They have played football*.
 
 
 
• In the active voice of the Present Perfect Simple, we have to change the structure, so the subject in the passive voice becomes the object in the active voice.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct Active Voice:__ *It seems that many developing nations have made great progress.*
